Akali.combo: For standard poke, send the ball to Akali with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Akali engages, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to hold your ground, then pull her in with Orianna R Command: Shockwave once you have the ball's position. In teamfights, attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave as they make contact.
Akali.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Since Akali may target you when she engages, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Akali.escape: Don't go deep just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; check her other mobility tools too. Look for a chance to land Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: Also account for Orianna's magic damage being less effective against Akali's high magic resistance.
Akali.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to combine last hitting with poke and manage your mana. Keep the ball toward Akali and stand behind it, but if Akali can engage, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield and resistances. If you lack vision, don't push the wave all the way; keep it near the center.
Akali.phase: Once you have items in the mid to late game, play around Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull in multiple enemies in teamfights.
Akali.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally in advance with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If Akali targets you, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield and resistances. Be ready to survive with the Zhonya's Hourglass you bought early, since you are easy to target right after using Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Akali.watch: Akali R Perfect Execution's second strike becomes stronger the more health has been lost.

Hwei.escape: Go in right after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used to poke or clear the wave. Hwei has no mobility spell, so you can catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave after closing the distance. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, an engaging ally may be pulled back or rooted.
Hwei.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Hwei’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Casting Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself gives you a shield, as well as magic resistance while the ball is attached to you.
Hwei.combo: For a basic poke, send the ball toward Hwei with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If an ally is engaging, attach the ball to them with Orianna E Command: Protect. As soon as they reach Hwei, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Check the ball’s position before casting R so you can pull Hwei toward your ally.
Hwei.fight: Early on, don’t force an engage. Send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used to poke or clear the wave, Hwei has fewer ways to retaliate, giving you a chance to close the distance. You can also attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect and send it toward Hwei.
Hwei.laning: Keep the ball near Hwei while you stand back, and use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time. Sending the ball where Hwei overlaps with the backline minions can also help clear the wave. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Hwei.phase: Orianna can be taken down easily if caught early, so after Hwei’s first spell hits, focus on dodging the follow-up attack. In mid to late game, once you have your items, look for chances to pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Hwei.teamfight: Take a wide path around corridors with Hwei’s placed zones, and look to engage as soon as Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull them toward your team. If you’re being targeted, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you in, you’re likely to get hit by the follow-up spells too. If the first spell hits, move immediately to dodge the second spell and Hwei P Signature of the Visionary’s explosion. Take a wide path around Hwei’s placed zones and the corridors with eyes.

Qiyana.phase: Orianna is weak if caught early, so survive without giving Qiyana room to engage. Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so don’t give her an advantage and build armor. Qiyana’s power falls off later while Orianna becomes strong in teamfights with items, so fight grouped with your team but stand away from terrain.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Early on, use Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well, since Qiyana may target you when she engages.
Qiyana.combo: To harass, send the ball to Qiyana with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When looking for Orianna R Command: Shockwave, first place the ball beyond or beside Qiyana, where it can pull her toward your team. From there, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Qiyana.escape: After letting Qiyana’s engage pass without catching you, go in when both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down. If only one is down, she can escape with the remaining mobility ability, so look for an opening before Qiyana E Audacity comes back. Catch her then with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack right after Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down. When Qiyana closes in, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield and armor. Once you’ve created distance, keep the ball near Qiyana and trade with Orianna Q Command: Attack and Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Qiyana.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and harass while managing your mana. Keep the ball near Qiyana while Orianna stays back to maintain her distance. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle.
Qiyana.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team. Even when grouped with your team, stand away from walls so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn’t catch you all. You may be targeted right after Orianna R Command: Shockwave, so survive with the Zhonya’s Hourglass you bought earlier.
Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with the river element, move out of range of the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it hits terrain and stuns, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages. If Qiyana disappears with the brush element, move into your team’s vision.

Yone.build: Get Zhonya's Hourglass early against an opponent like Yone, who has many ways to engage. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance instead of focusing on just one type of resistance.
Yone.combo: To poke, send the ball toward Yone with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When using Orianna R Command: Shockwave, place the ball beyond or beside Yone in advance, then follow up with R → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Yone.escape: Don't engage just because Yone used Yone E Soul Unbound. Check for Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed, and especially look for a chance to counterattack with Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance and poke with Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance while Yone's tornado isn't ready. If Yone dives in, protect yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect, check the ball's position, then respond with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Yone.laning: If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke.
Yone.phase: Orianna is easy to catch early, but gets stronger after unlocking Orianna R Command: Shockwave and acquiring items. In the mid and late game, look for openings with the ball and ultimate in team fights.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield doesn't grow. Don't stand alone at the very back of the formation, since Yone can dive into the back line when Yone R Fate Sealed hits you. Send the ball with an engaging ally using Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave as they reach the enemy to pull Yone and nearby enemies toward your ally.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, keep your distance until the tornado disappears. When Yone approaches with Yone E Soul Unbound, watch for the follow-up Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone R Fate Sealed, and protect yourself while retrieving the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect.

Sylas.laning: Keep the ball toward the enemy while Orianna stays behind it, and don’t push the wave all the way without vision. Immediately move out of the intersection point of Sylas Q Chain Lash.
Sylas.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Sylas’s main damage is magic, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy also has an engage assassin, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Sylas.combo: For basic harass, send the ball toward Sylas with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, place the ball where you want it in advance, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Sylas.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging the second chain of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a way to close distance, so don’t go too far in just because one ability is down. In particular, look for Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back.
Sylas.fight: Dodge the chains when Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If he gets on you, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield and resistances. Before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back, catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave to create a chance to kill him before Sylas W Kingslayer heals him.
Sylas.phase: Still, Orianna is vulnerable if caught early, so maintain your distance.
Sylas.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally in advance with Orianna E Command: Protect. The moment they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies together. If Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave and focus your attacks before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Be careful not to give Sylas R Hijack range to steal Orianna’s ultimate.
Sylas.watch: Be more careful of the chains Sylas throws afterward than of the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. If you fail to dodge the chains, you’ll be knocked up and hit by his combo, so time Flash to the chains. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move out immediately even if you’re only grazed by the first hit.

Ahri.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.combo: For standard poke, send the ball toward Ahri with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When you engage after Ahri R Spirit Rush has been fully spent, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm has also just been used, position the ball and pull Ahri in with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Ahri.fight: In short early trades, use basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Dodge Ahri E Charm from behind minions, then poke with Orianna Q Command: Attack followed by Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Ahri.laning: Move with the minion wave between you and Ahri to block Ahri E Charm. Send Orianna Q Command: Attack through Ahri and the minions behind her to combine last hitting with poke and manage your mana. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it near the center.
Ahri.phase: Orianna has low health and defenses early, so getting caught is dangerous. Play the lane safely and dodge Ahri E Charm.
Ahri.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you are targeted, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield and defensive stats.
Ahri.watch: Dodge Ahri E Charm by standing behind minions; otherwise, you may take all the follow-up damage. Ahri Q Orb of Deception also deals damage on its return, and that damage is true damage, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path.

Akshan.build: Akshan deals mostly physical damage, and Orianna has relatively low armor, so prioritize armor. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: To poke, send the ball to Akshan with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. After Akshan E Heroic Swing is used, place the ball beyond or beside him, then follow with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing has been spent is your window to engage. If he uses Akshan E Heroic Swing to approach and target you, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and armor, then create distance with the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Akshan.fight: Early, if Akshan approaches with basic attacks, trade using Orianna P Clockwork Windup, but don't let him keep you tied up for long. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used, keep the ball toward him and look for a chance to close the gap or catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Akshan.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to combine last hitting with poke and manage your mana. Akshan Q Avengerang can extend after hitting minions, so don't stand in a straight line behind the wave. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it near the center, and recall the ball when crossing dangerous areas.
Akshan.phase: Once you have items in the mid to late game, look for angles to gather multiple enemies with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Akshan.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, pull enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you are marked as a Scoundrel, fight outside Akshan's finishing range to prevent the revival from Akshan W Going Rogue. Help your team move in or retreat with Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so don't stand behind minions where it can hit you; dodge both its outgoing and returning paths. Akshan R Comeuppance becomes more dangerous the more health has been lost, so move behind terrain if he targets you while your health is low. If Akshan W Going Rogue marks you as a Scoundrel, don't face him alone.

Anivia.build: Early, get through the lane with Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Anivia.combo: For standard poke, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If you place the ball where Anivia has difficulty escaping, pull her in with Orianna R Command: Shockwave, then follow with Orianna Q Command: Attack and Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If you are targeted, recall the ball and gain a shield with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Anivia.escape: The moment Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down is your chance to close the gap. Anivia has no mobility ability, so place the ball where it can reach her and catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, don't go in; move out of Anivia R Glacial Storm.
Anivia.fight: After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When trading basic attacks at close range, use the empowered attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup. If Anivia turns into an egg with Anivia P Rebirth, don't overextend trying to finish her alone; pressure her with your team.
Anivia.laning: Send Orianna Q Command: Attack through Anivia and the minions behind her to combine last hitting with poke and manage your mana. Keep the ball toward Anivia while standing behind it yourself to stay away from Anivia Q Flash Frost. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it near the center.
Anivia.phase: Orianna gets stronger as the cooldown on Orianna Q Command: Attack shortens and she gains Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Her teamfight impact grows in the late game, but account for Anivia's terrain control and fight in open areas.
Anivia.teamfight: Send the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, and when they make contact, pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Choose where to place the ball in advance so you don't push enemies away from your team. Avoid narrow jungle and river paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and save Flash in case you get separated from your team.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes as it travels and stuns, so when poking from range, stay outside its range from the start. If it hits you, Anivia E Frostbite can follow with empowered damage, so protect yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect and move out of Anivia R Glacial Storm. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Annie.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Annie.combo: For standard poke, send the ball to Annie with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. To engage, place the ball beyond or beside Annie, then follow with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie P Pyromania's stun has just been used is your chance to engage. Annie has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap and catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun isn't ready, poke from range with Orianna Q Command: Attack.
Annie.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to combine last hitting with poke while managing your mana. Send the ball through Annie and the minions behind her, and if you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it near the center.
Annie.phase: Early, Orianna can easily be overwhelmed if caught, so dodge Annie's stun and keep your distance.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, don't stand grouped with your allies. Send the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, and when they reach the enemy, pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Annie.watch: If white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, so don't enter her ability range. Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Annie R Summon: Tibbers's area attack, and keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers too.

AurelionSol.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
AurelionSol.combo: For standard poke, send the ball to the enemy's position with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, place the ball beyond or beside him in a favorable position, then attack with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If things get dangerous, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield.
AurelionSol.escape: Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is a mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the gap. Position the ball and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you are caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, stop engaging and move outside immediately.
AurelionSol.fight: Early, use empowered attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup and Orianna Q Command: Attack for short trades to limit the time Aurelion Sol has to build Stardust. Don't let Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hit you for long, and close the gap to fight after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down. Orianna has no ability to escape on her own, so don't overcommit when her armor is reduced, such as just after sending out the ball.
AurelionSol.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to combine minion last hits with poke and manage your mana. While Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light is firing, stand behind minions but quickly move out of its line of fire so you don't give him Stardust. If you lack vision, poke while keeping the lane near the center instead of pushing it all the way.
AurelionSol.phase: Early, Aurelion Sol has little Stardust and Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight has a long cooldown, giving Orianna a chance to limit his growth with poke. However, Aurelion Sol's Stardust is permanent, so the more he is allowed to scale, the harder he is to face.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, and when they reach the enemy, pull multiple enemies toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Moving forward to cast with the ball on yourself should be a last resort. Spread out before engaging so multiple allies aren't hit together by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend once he has built up Stardust.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals extra damage and builds Stardust if it keeps hitting one target, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its line of fire. If caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, immediately walk out; when your health is low, avoid even the edge because of its execute threat. Once Stardust has built up, watch for the knock-up and area shockwave from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and spread out from your allies.

Aurora.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Aurora.combo: For basic poke, send the ball to Aurora with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, don't cast immediately; place the ball where she may reappear or wait for her to show again. When using Orianna R Command: Shockwave, place the ball beyond or beside Aurora, then chain R → Q → W.
Aurora.escape: Don't go in just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check whether she has also used Aurora E The Weirding. The window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back is especially good for catching her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If Aurora engages with a leap and fails to help secure a kill, counterattack before she can re-engage.
Aurora.fight: Use Orianna P Clockwork Windup to trade basic attacks early, but if health has decreased and you are hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, end the trade and retreat. If Aurora uses her mobility spell to engage and fails to help secure a kill, that is your chance to counterattack. Right after sending the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, you are vulnerable, so if Aurora approaches, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield.
Aurora.laning: Keep the ball near Aurora and stay behind it, using Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time. Aim where Aurora overlaps with the backline minions so you can spend mana to clear the wave and poke at once. When you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Aurora.phase: Orianna has low health and defenses early, so keep your distance to avoid being caught. In the mid-to-late game, once you have items, your strength is teamfights that use Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Aurora.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then when that ally reaches Aurora, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull Aurora and nearby enemies toward your team. If Aurora uses her leap and fails to kill anyone, catch her then. If an ally dies, Aurora's leap cooldown resets, so don't leave a low-health ally behind as you retreat.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again when it returns, so move out of the line between you and Aurora. The lower your health, the more damage the returning curse deals, so retreat instead of staying while cursed. When Aurora R Between Worlds appears, you are slowed when leaving it, so create distance before the zone forms.

Azir.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Azir deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Azir.combo: For standard poke, send the ball toward Azir with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then trigger Orianna W Command: Dissonance when it arrives. After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, place the ball beyond or beside him, then burst him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Azir.escape: The moment Azir E Shifting Sands is down is your window to close the gap. When Azir Q Conquering Sands is down and he can't move his soldiers, engage while avoiding the straight line where they stand. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, don't enter narrow passages together.
Azir.fight: Poke briefly while avoiding the soldiers' attack paths when they are stationary or Azir Q Conquering Sands is down. Once Azir E Shifting Sands is also down, put the ball toward Azir and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave to unleash your damage all at once.
Azir.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to combine last hitting with poke and manage your mana. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it near the center, and pressure him when the soldiers' duration ends or Azir has spent mana.
Azir.phase: Early, farm safely because Orianna can easily be overwhelmed if caught, but look for chances to pressure Azir with your jungler before he gets Azir R Emperor's Divide. Both champions become strong later, so stay at a distance from Azir's soldiers and look for teamfight angles with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Azir.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally in advance with Orianna E Command: Protect, and when they reach the enemy, pull multiple enemies, including Azir, toward your team with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Engage from multiple directions in open areas so you aren't all knocked back together by Azir R Emperor's Divide. If you are targeted, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances.
Azir.watch: Don't stand for long in the attack paths of soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise!, and watch their positions before Azir moves them with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Azir R Emperor's Divide knocks back engaging allies and leaves a wall, so don't dive in together through narrow passages.

Corki.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to address Corki's main damage, but keep in mind that armor alone won't counter Corki E Gatling Gun's resistance reduction or Corki P Hextech Munitions' true damage.
Corki.combo: For basic poke, send the ball to Corki with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. After Corki W Valkyrie is down, place the ball beyond or beside Corki and chain Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Corki.escape: The moment after you make Corki use Corki W Valkyrie is your chance to go in. Slow him with Orianna W Command: Dissonance, then place the ball well and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to stop him from escaping.
Corki.fight: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie, he has no mobility available, so close the gap with the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki's farming and manage your mana by using Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time. Keep the ball near Corki and stand behind it, but without vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. When dodging Corki R Missile Barrage, move out of range instead of behind minions.
Corki.phase: Corki also gets stronger as he builds items, so don't give him time to farm comfortably.
Corki.teamfight: Send the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then when that ally reaches the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team. If you are targeted, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances.
Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of holding your ground in front of it. Corki R Missile Barrage also damages nearby targets around the first target it hits, so don't hide behind minions; move out of range, especially to avoid taking the third missile in a row. Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals your position for a while if it hits, so immediately create distance if you're retreating.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko's damage, and buy Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier if Ekko's engage is a threat.
Ekko.combo: To poke, send the ball toward Ekko with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look for Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you place the ball beyond or beside Ekko before using your ultimate, chain Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Ekko.escape: Don't go in deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Your chance to fully engage comes after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. In particular, look for Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back.
Ekko.fight: For a short trade, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then trigger Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, protect yourself and recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect. Respond with Orianna R Command: Shockwave the moment Ekko's mobility spell is spent.
Ekko.laning: Orianna is at risk if caught early, so keep the ball toward the enemy and stand behind it. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time, but manage your mana. Without vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Ekko.phase: Orianna is weak early, so keep your distance to avoid being caught by Ekko's engage. In the mid-to-late game, once you have items, focus on pulling multiple enemies together with your ultimate in teamfights.
Ekko.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave when that ally reaches the enemy, including Ekko. If Ekko has just closed in with Ekko E Phase Dive, you have a chance to respond with your ultimate. Be mindful of surviving afterward, since Ekko may target you after you use your ultimate.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder's returning hit is stronger, so also move out of its return path. When you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don't chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Since Fizz is an assassin who engages, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to give yourself a way to survive after using Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Fizz.combo: To poke, send the ball to Fizz with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then trigger Orianna W Command: Dissonance when it arrives. After Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, place the ball where you want it first, then chain Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Fizz.escape: The moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down is the clearest window to counterattack. Fizz Q Urchin Strike is also a mobility spell, so don't go in deep just because one ability is down; use Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back.
Fizz.fight: Trade when Fizz misses a last hit and Fizz W Seastone Trident goes on its full cooldown. When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Check whether Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available before using Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Fizz.laning: Manage your mana while using Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time. Keep the ball near Fizz, but stand behind it; without vision, don't push the lane all the way, and keep it in the middle. Watch Fizz's last hits and look for the moment he wastes Fizz W Seastone Trident on a missed last hit.
Fizz.phase: Orianna can easily be taken down if caught early, so watch for Fizz's engage and keep the lane in the middle. Right after Fizz uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster early, you have a chance to poke. Orianna gets stronger as she gains Orianna R Command: Shockwave and builds items; in the mid-to-late game, look for opportunities to pull multiple enemies together in teamfights.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to an ally and make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first; after it's down, focus him together. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave the moment they reach the enemy to pull several enemies toward your team. If Fizz targets you, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect and gain a shield.
Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz times his engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike to coincide with the knock-up, so send Orianna Q Command: Attack down that path and slow him with Orianna W Command: Dissonance to make him use Fizz E Playful / Trickster.

Galio.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build that resistance first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Galio.combo: For basic poke, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Galio's engage tools are down, place the ball beyond or beside Galio and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Set the ball's position first so Orianna R Command: Shockwave pulls Galio toward your team.
Galio.escape: Don't go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for a chance to engage when Galio R Hero's Entrance is also not back yet and you've avoided his crowd control. Catch Galio then with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Galio.fight: Take advantage of Galio being a melee champion by keeping your distance and poking with Orianna Q Command: Attack. When Orianna is targeted, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect and gain a shield.
Galio.laning: Send Orianna Q Command: Attack where the enemy overlaps with the backline minions to last-hit and poke at the same time, and manage your mana. Without vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. After Galio uses mana to clear the wave with his abilities, push the lane to limit his time to affect other lanes.
Galio.phase: Orianna is at a major disadvantage if caught early, so keep your distance and poke. In the mid-to-late game, once you have items, look for Orianna R Command: Shockwave opportunities to pull multiple enemies together in teamfights.
Galio.teamfight: Send the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then the moment they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull several enemies toward your team. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, leave the area first. When you need to retreat together, place the ball near an ally and use the movement speed effect from Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Galio.watch: When you see Galio W Shield of Durand charging, don't unload your damage; move out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its backward windup, and leave the point where the gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, immediately leave the area.

Irelia.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Orianna has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: For basic poke, send the ball to Irelia with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, if you've already placed the ball beside or beyond Irelia, attack with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is your window to close the gap. If Orianna R Command: Shockwave hits then, Irelia will have a hard time escaping.
Irelia.fight: Early on, avoid the range from which Irelia can dash in on low-health minions while poking with Orianna Q Command: Attack. Right after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge, you have a chance to close the gap and attack; if you are targeted, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect and gain a shield.
Irelia.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time, and manage your mana. Don't leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia, and without vision, don't fully push the lane; keep it in the middle.
Irelia.phase: In the mid-to-late game, once you have items, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Irelia.teamfight: In teamfights, prioritize targeting Irelia to stop her from taking over the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then as soon as that ally reaches the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull Irelia and nearby enemies toward your team.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain across low-health minions to close in, so step back when a minion is about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you're trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: To poke, send the ball toward Karma with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When you have a chance to pull Karma in, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If you’re in danger while the ball is away from you, cast Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and shield.
Karma.escape: Go in after Karma W Focused Resolve is down, so you don’t have to worry about its root, and after the shield from Karma E Inspire has expired. Place the ball where Orianna R Command: Shockwave will pull Karma toward your team, then cast it.
Karma.fight: Early on, if Karma walks up to basic attack, take a short trade with Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Don’t force an engage while Karma W Focused Resolve is available; keep your distance. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire has expired, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack to attack.
Karma.laning: Keep the ball near Karma while you stand back, and use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke while managing your mana. Sending the ball where Karma overlaps with the backline minions can help clear the wave and poke at the same time. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Karma.phase: Early on, Orianna is fragile and in danger if caught, so focus on managing your distance. In mid to late game, once you have your items, look for chances to pull multiple enemies together with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Karma.teamfight: Bait out Karma W Focused Resolve first, then engage after the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has expired. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. As soon as they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team. When you need to retreat together, place the ball near your ally and use Orianna W Command: Dissonance to grant movement speed.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame deals area damage and slows, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid being hit. If you’re hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, move outside the circle before the remaining zone detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you.

Kassadin.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Kassadin’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Against an engaging assassin like Kassadin, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, send the ball toward him with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then detonate Orianna W Command: Dissonance as it arrives. While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, place the ball where it will pull him in, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Kassadin.escape: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have a chance to engage. Place the ball near Kassadin and pull him in with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is also down, you can fight without being slowed.
Kassadin.fight: Poke with magic damage while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. If Kassadin engages, protect yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect and recall the ball.
Kassadin.laning: If you have vision and jungle pressure, push the wave to keep Kassadin under his turret. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle and avoid using spells unnecessarily near Kassadin.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, Kassadin can dive the backline, so don’t stand alone. Prepare to use the ball in teamfights as Orianna.
Kassadin.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. As soon as they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team. If Kassadin targets you, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and magic resistance. You may be targeted immediately after using your ultimate, so survive with the Zhonya’s Hourglass you bought early.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere gives him a shield that absorbs magic damage, so poke after it’s down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows and its cooldown is reduced whenever nearby spells are cast, so avoid using spells unnecessarily.

Leblanc.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive early, then choose Mercury’s Treads. LeBlanc’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. If you need to withstand her engage, get Zhonya’s Hourglass early so you have a way to survive after using Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Leblanc.combo: For a basic poke, send the ball toward LeBlanc with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. After the return window for LeBlanc W Distortion has expired or she has used the return, place the ball where it will pull her toward your team, then chain Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Leblanc.escape: Right after you make LeBlanc use W Distortion, you have a window to close the distance. Once its return window has expired or she has used the return, look for a chance to catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, first move outside its range to avoid the root. If you’re being targeted, recall the ball and gain a shield with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Leblanc.fight: If your opponent walks up to basic attack, take a short trade with the empowered basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup. For a spell trade, send the ball toward your opponent, then slow them with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Look to counterattack after the return window for LeBlanc W Distortion has expired or she has already used the return.
Leblanc.laning: Keep the ball near your opponent while you stand back, and look to last-hit and poke with Orianna Q Command: Attack. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle to prepare for LeBlanc’s engage and a jungle gank. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid lane.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, Orianna is fragile and has no escape spell, so keep your distance and watch out for LeBlanc’s engage and root. Orianna gets stronger once Orianna Q Command: Attack has a shorter cooldown and you’ve learned Orianna R Command: Shockwave. In mid to late game, once you have your items, look for chances to pull multiple enemies together with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Leblanc.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally ahead of time with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team. If LeBlanc is about to target you, cast Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield. When an ally engages or you retreat together, use Orianna W Command: Dissonance from the ball near your ally to help with movement speed.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc’s Q Sigil of Malice mark is still on you, getting hit by a follow-up spell increases the damage you take, so fall back and give the mark time to disappear. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains only roots you if the chain remains attached after it hits, so move outside its range as soon as you’re hit. LeBlanc can engage with W Distortion, so be especially careful to keep your distance right after sending the ball far away.

Lissandra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lissandra’s damage is mostly magic, and she also has a root and a stun, so get magic resistance and tenacity.
Lissandra.combo: For a basic poke, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If she can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, spread out your damage until her stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is used, you have a chance to close the distance. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses, you have a shorter window to worry about its root, so trade. When both spells are available, keep your distance because Orianna has no way to escape on her own.
Lissandra.fight: Early on, close the distance and trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down. Send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, slow her with Orianna W Command: Dissonance, then use basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup from a safe distance. If Lissandra has also used E Glacial Path, look for a chance to catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it pierces. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to target both Lissandra and the backline minions for last-hits and poke, while managing your mana. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Orianna is in serious danger if caught, so focus on surviving and managing your distance. In mid to late game, once you have your items, look for chances to pull multiple enemies together with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in teamfights.
Lissandra.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team. If the ball is near an ally, Orianna W Command: Dissonance can grant movement speed when engaging or retreating together. Decide when to engage based on whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, and time your damage so you can keep dealing it after the self-inflicted stasis from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb ends.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a straight line with your allied minions. If you are rooted by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or stunned by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, you are likely to take follow-up damage, so keep your distance. When you’re in danger, recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances.

Lux.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lux’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, send the ball to her with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then detonate Orianna W Command: Dissonance as it arrives. If you have an angle to pull Lux toward your team, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Lux.escape: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, you have a chance to close the distance. Lux has no mobility spell, so once you get close, you can catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Lux.fight: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If a Lux spell hits you and applies the Illumination mark, move outside her basic attack range. If you’re being targeted, recall the ball and gain a shield with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Lux.laning: Keep the ball near Lux while you stand back, and use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time. Look for a spot where Lux overlaps with the backline minions, but if you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Lux.phase: Early on, Orianna is fragile, so be careful not to get caught by Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from a different direction so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t catch you together. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. As soon as they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, she can follow up with more spells, so bait it out first and move once it misses. You can still be rooted as the second target even when standing behind an ally, so stand off to the side. If you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark, move to the side.

Malzahar.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to help you survive early, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Malzahar.combo: Send the ball toward Malzahar with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first. Place the ball in a good spot beyond or beside Malzahar, then chain Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Malzahar.escape: Go in after dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void, when Malzahar W Void Swarm has no summons, and after removing Malzahar P Void Shift. Malzahar has no spell to create distance, so after closing in, you can catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. However, don’t engage alone if Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Orianna Q Command: Attack before fighting. For a short trade, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then follow up with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Use Orianna P Clockwork Windup when you have a chance to basic attack. After you dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void, the moment the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm disappear is your chance to engage.
Malzahar.laning: Move away from minions afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions and wait until the effect has finished transferring. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke while managing your mana. If you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way, and pressure Malzahar with your jungler when he pushes forward.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, use Orianna P Clockwork Windup for short trades, and pressure Malzahar with your jungler to limit his time to scale. Orianna’s teamfight impact grows once she has Orianna R Command: Shockwave and her items. Malzahar also gets stronger over time, so in the late game, fight with your team instead of trying to catch him alone.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm has already summoned its creatures, clear them first with an area spell such as Orianna Q Command: Attack. Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your team. If an ally is caught by Malzahar R Nether Grasp, interrupt Malzahar’s cast with your ally’s immobilizing crowd control.
Malzahar.watch: If a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to a nearby enemy, so move away from that minion. If you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move out from between the two rifts to avoid the silence. Orianna E Command: Protect cannot remove the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so don’t enter an area where you have no vision alone while he can use it.

Mel.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Most of Mel’s damage is magic, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: Bait out Mel W Rebuttal or confirm it’s down, then poke with Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When catching Mel with Orianna R Command: Shockwave, place the ball beside or behind her ahead of time, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Mel.escape: Go in after Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down. Mel has no mobility spell, so if you close the distance, position the ball to catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If Orianna is being targeted, cast Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield.
Mel.fight: Early on, if your opponent walks up to basic attack, take a short trade with an empowered basic attack from Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Once Mel W Rebuttal is down, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. After dodging Mel E Solar Snare and with Mel W Rebuttal down, you have a chance to close the distance.
Mel.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to last-hit and poke at the same time, while managing your mana. Pressure Mel from early on to limit her time to scale, but if you don’t have vision, don’t push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. Even if the ball is near your opponent, stand back and leave yourself room to sidestep Mel E Solar Snare.
Mel.phase: Orianna is strong in mid to late game teamfights once she has her items, but Mel also gets stronger over time, so keep limiting her time to scale.
Mel.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. As soon as they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull Mel toward your team. Send the ball through an ally instead of diving in with it on yourself, and recall it with Orianna E Command: Protect if you’re targeted. When engaging or retreating together, use Orianna W Command: Dissonance from the ball near your ally to help with movement speed.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles, so use Orianna Q Command: Attack carefully until Mel W Rebuttal is down. Mel E Solar Snare roots targets hit in the center, so sidestep it.

Naafiri.build: Naafiri’s main damage is physical, and Orianna has relatively low armor, so build Cloth Armor first to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to prepare for her engage. If the duel goes long, consider Grievous Wounds after building armor.
Naafiri.combo: For basic harass, use Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance to slow at the ball’s arrival point. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives the pack, clear it with the area damage from Orianna Q Command: Attack and counterattack. If Naafiri’s mobility ability is down, place the ball where it can pull her toward your team, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Naafiri.escape: If only one of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate is down, she can escape with the remaining mobility ability, so don’t rush your engage. Your chance to catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave comes when her other mobility ability is also down, especially before Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit comes back. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, wait until she can be targeted again.
Naafiri.fight: Keep your distance and harass with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then slow with Orianna W Command: Dissonance as the ball arrives. If Naafiri closes in with Naafiri E Eviscerate, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield and armor. Don’t go too far in while Naafiri still has her mobility ability.
Naafiri.laning: Farm behind the minion line and harass melee-range Naafiri with Orianna Q Command: Attack. Sending the ball where Naafiri overlaps with the backline minions lets you farm and harass at the same time. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, Orianna can be easily overwhelmed if caught, but you can harass Naafiri with your range advantage. Naafiri’s roams are most dangerous in the mid game, so maintain wide vision and don’t move around alone.
Naafiri.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team. If Naafiri is about to target you, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball, then make use of Orianna W Command: Dissonance's slow and its movement speed boost for allies. You’re easy to target right after using Orianna R Command: Shockwave, so survive with the Zhonya’s Hourglass you bought earlier.
Naafiri.watch: After being hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers, you’ll bleed and take more damage from the second hit, so create distance until the bleed ends. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so attack after it ends. Don’t move around alone if Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is ready.

Ryze.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Ryze’s main damage is magic, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: For basic harass, send the ball toward Ryze with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If an ally is engaging, attach the ball to them with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach Ryze, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Ryze.escape: After Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison are down, look for an angle to catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave without worrying about a mark leading into a root.
Ryze.fight: Before Ryze scales, apply brief pressure with the empowered attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup and Orianna Q Command: Attack. If being hit by Ryze E Spell Flux puts you at risk of being rooted, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield and magic resistance.
Ryze.laning: Keep the ball near Ryze while Orianna stays back. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and harass while managing your mana. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle while harassing.
Ryze.phase: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, but Orianna is also very weak, so pressure his scaling from a distance where he can’t catch you.
Ryze.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally in advance with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach Ryze and the enemy group, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team. If Ryze casts Ryze R Realm Warp, look for an angle to interrupt Ryze himself with Orianna R Command: Shockwave before it activates.
Ryze.watch: When Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, Ryze Q Overload is empowered, and the following Ryze W Rune Prison roots you. Prioritize dodging the mark; if you’re hit, separate from your allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears.

Syndra.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Syndra’s main magic damage, then choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Account for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power by considering your total health as well as your magic resistance.
Syndra.combo: For basic harass, send the ball toward Syndra with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and you have a chance to engage, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Check the ball’s position first, since Orianna R Command: Shockwave pulls Syndra toward it.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-defense, so right after she uses it is your chance to close the distance. Take advantage of Syndra having no mobility to catch her with the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance, and pull her in with Orianna R Command: Shockwave if the ball is positioned to reach her.
Syndra.fight: Early on, if Syndra approaches with basic attacks, trade briefly with attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup. After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, pressure her by sending the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and slowing with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If you’re targeted, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield.
Syndra.laning: If you lack vision, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and harass. Keep the ball near Syndra while Orianna stays back, but remember that Orianna E Command: Protect’s ongoing defensive effect ends while the ball is away from you. Get boots early so you can dodge Syndra’s ground-targeted abilities by walking.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Orianna is very fragile, so trade briefly while avoiding stun angles from Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Syndra’s abilities change when they reach max rank, so reassess your distance after their visual effects change.
Syndra.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach Syndra, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull her toward your team. Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous in areas with multiple Syndra Q Dark Sphere casts on the ground, so reposition to find an angle. If you’re targeted, use Orianna E Command: Protect on yourself to recall the ball and gain a shield.
Syndra.watch: Magic resistance can’t reduce the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will. Syndra R Unleashed Power can execute targets at low health, so don’t enter an area with many spheres on the ground when health has been depleted.

Talon.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand Talon’s physical damage, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier against Talon, an engage assassin. Talon has relatively high magic resistance, so include magic penetration in your offensive items.
Talon.combo: For basic harass, send the ball to Talon with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. After Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, check the ball’s position and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave, then follow with Orianna Q Command: Attack and Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Talon.escape: The moment after making Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the distance and fight. It’s a good time to counterattack once you confirm he has also used Talon R Shadow Assault, but stop chasing if it’s still available, accounting for his stealth.
Talon.fight: Given Talon’s early burst damage, don’t go too far in first. Keep the ball near Talon and harass from behind. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, counterattack by sending the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and slowing him with Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Talon.laning: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and harass, but don’t push the wave all the way if you lack vision. Talon can roam over terrain, so keep sharing his position and place vision along the jungle paths.
Talon.phase: Orianna gains strength after unlocking Orianna R Command: Shockwave and building items. Talon’s influence falls off later, so play to group up and start teamfights.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon enters your backline, shield yourself and recall the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect, then catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If your team engages first, attach the ball to that ally with Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team as they reach them.
Talon.watch: If you are hit by both the outgoing and returning blades of Talon W Rake, Talon P Blade’s End is easier to proc, so if you’re hit by the first strike, move out of the return path. Don’t chase recklessly while Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy’s dash and Talon R Shadow Assault’s stealth are still available.

TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Twisted Fate’s main damage is magic, and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: For basic harass, send the ball toward Twisted Fate with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. To catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave, place the ball beyond or beside him in advance, then use R → Q → W to pull him toward your team.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses his gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to go in without worrying about a stun.
TwistedFate.fight: When Twisted Fate’s gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is down, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and harass with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Twisted Fate trades with basic attacks, respond with attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup, but keep your distance while he holds a gold card.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce harass damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Send Orianna Q Command: Attack where Twisted Fate overlaps with the backline minions to last hit and harass while managing your mana. If you lack vision, don’t push the wave all the way; keep it in the middle.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Orianna is in danger if caught, so trade carefully while staying out of gold card range. Orianna comes into her own in mid to late game teamfights, once her abilities and items are ready, by pulling multiple enemies together with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. The moment they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your team. If Twisted Fate R Destiny becomes visible and the ball is in range, interrupt his movement with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you’re targeted, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain a shield and defensive stats.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate locks in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, his basic attack stuns, so stand outside basic attack range until he no longer holds the card.

Veigar.build: Veigar deals mostly magic damage and Orianna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.combo: For a basic trade, send the ball to Veigar with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When an ally engages, attach the ball to them with Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave as they reach the enemy. If you have an opening to catch Veigar with the ball beyond or beside him, follow up with Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility spell to create distance, so engage after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. When an ally engages first, send the ball with them using Orianna E Command: Protect, then catch Veigar with Orianna R Command: Shockwave when it reaches him.
Veigar.fight: Pressure Veigar while he's weak early, but keep your distance since getting caught is dangerous for Orianna, too. Send the ball toward Veigar with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Keep moving even when weaving in basic attacks so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. If you are targeted, retrieve the ball and gain a shield with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Veigar.laning: If Veigar Q Baleful Strike keeps hitting you, you'll help Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stack, so dodge it by standing behind minions. Send Orianna Q Command: Attack where Veigar and the minions behind him overlap to combine last hitting and poking, and manage your mana. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle while poking.
Veigar.phase: Veigar gets stronger over time through Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power stacks, so pressure him early. Before late-game objective fights, check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.teamfight: Send the ball with an engaging ally using Orianna E Command: Protect. As they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your ally. Place the ball where it can pull enemies toward your team, and use Orianna W Command: Dissonance from the ball near your ally to help them engage or retreat. If you are targeted, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Veigar.watch: If Veigar E Event Horizon traps you, don't cross the edge; move inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter's landing spot is shown in advance, so watch the ground indicator and sidestep. If your health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Vex deals mostly magic damage and Orianna has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Vex.combo: For a basic trade, send the ball to Vex with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Vex's Doom and shield are down and you have an opening to kill her with your ultimate, place the ball beyond or beside her, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Vex.escape: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom has been used on the wave or to poke and Vex W Personal Space is also down, look for a chance to catch her with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom and Vex W Personal Space are down. Keep the ball near Vex and poke with Orianna Q Command: Attack followed by Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Vex engages, protect yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect and retrieve the ball.
Vex.laning: Keep your distance early so you don't get caught. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke, and manage your mana. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. Remember that while the ball is near Vex, Orianna E Command: Protect's passive bonus armor and magic resistance are gone.
Vex.phase: Orianna is fragile early, so play carefully to avoid getting caught and take advantage of the window before Vex R Shadow Surge is available. Once you have items in the mid and late game, look for chances to catch multiple enemies with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in team fights.
Vex.teamfight: Attach the ball to an ally who is engaging with Orianna E Command: Protect. As they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your ally. If a low-health ally is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, move them out of Vex's range first so she can't get the first kill. If Vex dashes in after the mark, target that spot together with your allies.
Vex.watch: When the Doom indicator for Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is visible, watch out for her fear and look for an opening right after she uses it on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so dodge with a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and marks you, move toward your allies and prepare for her dash.

Viktor.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: To poke Viktor, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then detonate Orianna W Command: Dissonance when it arrives. After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, if you have an opening to engage, place the ball beyond or beside Viktor and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Viktor.escape: If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, walk out of its area before engaging. While Viktor W Gravity Field is down, close the distance and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave, since he has no dash.
Viktor.fight: Keep the ball near Viktor and poke from outside Viktor W Gravity Field. If Viktor tries a short trade with basic attacks, respond with Orianna P Clockwork Windup's empowered basic attack. If you are targeted, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances.
Viktor.laning: In the early game, use Orianna Q Command: Attack for last hits and poke before Viktor P Glorious Evolution has stacked up. Don't stand where Viktor E Hextech Ray can hit both you and the wave, and don't push the lane all the way if you lack vision.
Viktor.phase: The early game, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution has stacked up, is a good time to pressure him.
Viktor.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach Viktor, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your ally. Don't stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field. When engaging or retreating together with your allies, use Orianna W Command: Dissonance from the ball near them to grant movement speed.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with minions and sidestep it. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, stop trading inside it and leave immediately to avoid the stun.

Vladimir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Add Grievous Wounds if preparing for extended fights.
Vladimir.combo: Use Orianna Q Command: Attack to first bait Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Once the pool ends, place the ball beyond or beside Vladimir and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Don't use a decisive ability while the pool is still active; bait it out first with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then engage.
Vladimir.fight: When Vladimir slows himself while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, dodge the wave while looking for a chance to close the distance. If you are targeted, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances.
Vladimir.laning: Keep the ball near Vladimir and stand behind it. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke. Send the ball when Vladimir and the minions behind him overlap, but if you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Vladimir.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies, including Vladimir, toward your ally. Time it for when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down. If infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, retreat until the effect ends.
Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so retreat until the effect ends and avoid grouping with allies.

Xerath.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance to counter Xerath's primary damage.
Xerath.combo: For a basic trade, send the ball toward Xerath with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. When you have a chance to get close to Xerath, place the ball beside or beyond him and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. First check that the ball is positioned to pull Xerath toward your ally.
Xerath.escape: Engage right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down. Xerath has no mobility spell, so close the distance and catch him with Orianna R Command: Shockwave. You also have an opportunity to engage while Xerath is rooted in place during Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.fight: While Xerath is slowed as he charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, sidestep and close the distance. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, send the ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack and poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Xerath walks up for a basic attack early, trade with Orianna P Clockwork Windup's empowered basic attack.
Xerath.laning: Keep the ball near Xerath and stand behind it. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke.
