Farm while avoiding Xerath's heavy damage, and push the lane and call your jungler after Xerath has spent a lot of mana. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle.
Xerath.phase: Orianna is very fragile early and Xerath's long range is threatening, so farm while avoiding his heavy damage. When Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and create an opportunity with your jungler.
Xerath.teamfight: Attach the ball in advance to an ally who is engaging with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your ally. If you are targeted, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and resistances. When helping an ally engage or retreat together, use Orianna W Command: Dissonance from the ball near them to grant movement speed.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you could take his entire follow-up combo, so be especially careful of that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and sidestep. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo's main damage is physical and Orianna has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Yasuo.combo: Send the ball to Yasuo's position with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance to hit when it arrives. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is positioned to block your key ability, move to a spot that goes around it or wait for it to disappear. When you need to pull Yasuo toward your ally, place the ball beyond or beside the enemy group and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave → Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest's tornado is down is your chance to attack. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is a mobility ability with a short cooldown, so don't go deep just because he has used it once. Coordinate with your allies' crowd control and use Orianna R Command: Shockwave before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light poke, then trade with Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so attack then. If Yasuo gets close, protect yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect and regain your distance.
Yasuo.laning: Yasuo uses minions as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so if you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. If the wave is thin and pushed toward your side, Yasuo has fewer stepping stones to approach. Use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke, and manage your mana.
Yasuo.phase: Orianna can easily be taken down if caught early, so prioritize your distance and the lane state. Once you have items in the mid and late game, look for chances to catch multiple enemies with Orianna R Command: Shockwave in team fights.
Yasuo.teamfight: Attach the ball in advance to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull enemies toward your ally. While the ball is away from you, Orianna E Command: Protect's passive bonus armor and magic resistance are gone, so retrieve the ball and gain a shield if you are targeted. You can also use Orianna W Command: Dissonance to grant movement speed when your allies engage or retreat together.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the distance, so be careful not to get caught near them. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, his next tornado can knock you up; watch for the effect and sidestep out of its line. Since Yasuo R Last Breath can follow the knock-up, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect and gain a shield when you're in danger.

Zed.build: Build armor early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed's main damage is physical and Orianna has low armor, so build armor early. Get Zhonya's Hourglass early as well to counter Zed, an assassin who dives in.
Zed.combo: For a basic trade, send the ball to Zed's position with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then use Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Zed engages, attach the ball to yourself with Orianna E Command: Protect, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave on the Zed who has come close to interrupt his follow-up damage during the mark.
Zed.escape: Right after Zed W Living Shadow is down is your chance to start a fight, but Zed can still escape with Zed R Death Mark if it is available. Engage after both mobility spells are down and before Zed R Death Mark is available again, and look for an opportunity to use Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Zed.fight: Trade after Zed W Living Shadow disappears or after Zed has already switched positions with the shadow. Send the ball toward Zed with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then poke with Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Zed engages and targets you, retrieve the ball and gain a shield with Orianna E Command: Protect.
Zed.laning: Keep your distance early so you don't get caught, and use Orianna Q Command: Attack for both last hits and poke. If you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. While the ball is near the enemy, Orianna E Command: Protect's passive armor bonus is gone, so watch for Zed's engage.
Zed.phase: Orianna is weak early, so be careful not to give Zed an advantage. Zed is strongest in the mid game, so group with allies then to avoid getting caught alone. Zed's strength falls off late, while Orianna is strong in team fights once she has items.
Zed.teamfight: Attach the ball to an engaging ally with Orianna E Command: Protect. When they reach the enemy, use Orianna R Command: Shockwave to pull multiple enemies toward your ally. If Zed targets you, retrieve the ball with Orianna E Command: Protect to gain a shield and armor. Be ready to survive with Zhonya's Hourglass right after the ultimate is used.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move out of the slow area from Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark marks you, interrupt his combo with Orianna R Command: Shockwave by knocking him away or pulling him in so he can't stack more damage. You can avoid the damage when the mark detonates with Zhonya's Hourglass.

Zoe.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Most of Zoe's damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble's true damage cannot be mitigated by resistance, so keep focusing on dodging the bubble even after you have your items.
Zoe.combo: For basic poke, send the ball to Zoe with Orianna Q Command: Attack, then trigger Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If Zoe moves with Zoe R Portal Jump, place the ball at the starting point she must return to. When Zoe throws Zoe Q Paddle Star! and is about to redirect it, you can interrupt that action with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Zoe.escape: The moment after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to engage. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the starting point she will return to instead of chasing her to where she moved.
Zoe.fight: Early on, if Zoe trades with basic attacks, trade back with the empowered attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup. To poke, send the ball toward Zoe, then use Orianna Q Command: Attack → Orianna W Command: Dissonance. Once Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, send the ball in as your allies engage and fight with them.
Zoe.laning: Keep the ball near Zoe while standing back, and use Orianna Q Command: Attack to both last-hit and poke. Aim where Zoe overlaps with the minions behind her to clear the wave and poke at the same time. When you lack vision, don't push the lane all the way; keep it in the middle. When passing through a dangerous area, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball.
Zoe.phase: Orianna has low defensive stats early, so play patiently and take care not to get caught by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble. In the mid and late game, once you have your items, look for opportunities in team fights to group several enemies with Orianna R Command: Shockwave.
Zoe.teamfight: Use Orianna E Command: Protect to attach the ball to an engaging ally in advance, then use Orianna R Command: Shockwave when that ally reaches Zoe. When positioning the ball, look for an angle that can pull Zoe toward your allies. If you become a target, use Orianna E Command: Protect to recall the ball and gain its shield and defensive stats.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you will fall asleep shortly afterward and may take follow-up attacks, so dodge the bubble first. If it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Even a bubble that misses remains as a trap, so watch narrow paths and brush entrances when you lack vision.
